title: anchor stone — whole
description: a dark stone obelisk of the chancellery rite about 1.2 times a character's height, square in section, bound with three bands of plain dull-violet metal that glow faintly pink-violet, a soft violet haze around it, standing on the floor (no letters, no symbols)

title: anchor stone — broken
description: the SAME obelisk, same size and position, now broken: split down the middle with the top half fallen beside it in two chunks, the bands dark and cold, no light, a little dust
